BAM_access: Indexed nine-site fetches only. No new whole-BAM hash/scan/alignment. Original files not modified.
public_reference: Existing local GRCh38 primary assembly and GENCODE37 references; no new download.
method_validation: Baseline/clean counts equal independent original9-site counters; synthetic CIGAR controls; seven normal-parent/edit/splice controls; repeat ambiguity and caps explicitly retained; independent root670 affine cases all agree.
scope: A bounded representative quality/origin review, not clinical genotype validation, sample identity probability or contamination quantification.
preservation: All work confined to this new resident subdirectory; parent primary-count files and priorv2 reports unchanged.
artifact_reproducibility: Specific-context metrics checked against reconstruction from preserved extraction without overwriting source output; query position mapping and all full-read alignments preserved.
